notes: S2-FIX4 F83 (decision 2026-11-16 #4; §5.3, §11.3): key-lifecycle/rotated-material-tofu with key-old's signature on the rotation broken and the manifest signed by key-new, which the case's keyset does not declare. The rotation is invalid E_SIG_INVALID, so it supplies no material (§5.3: only a semantically valid rotation does): the manifest entry by key-new is judged as an undeclared key's, E_KEY_UNKNOWN, and the note by key-new is unverifiable E_KEY_UNKNOWN. No check used context material (no L_KEY_TRUST_TOFU).
